reasons: Datadog sums the redis.expires series (sum:), but the candidate uses avg(), which changes the aggregation and the value.
The $host template variable has prefix host and default *, so it should become host=~"$host". The candidate has no host matcher, so it selects a different set of series.
$scope has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct. $key is not used in the query, so it does not apply.
The candidate outcome is translated, which is appropriate: the metric exists in the dataset and gauge data needs no rate().
The dataset does not list a host label among observed labels (only redis_version), so the label name for the host matcher needs confirmation against the dataset before the corrected PromQL is final.
